app_info.subtitle: Personal health analytics
app_info.description: Dofek helps users review server-computed health trends, sleep, activities, nutrition, body metrics, subjective health events, and connected provider status, with optional food logging and provider sync actions.

test_cases.description: Show daily HRV and steps across an exact date range.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my HRV and step trend from August 18 through August 31, 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns complete daily HRV and step coverage for all 14 requested days with server-computed aggregates.

test_cases.description: Open the interactive analytics visualization for two metrics.
test_cases.user_prompt: Open the Dofek Analytics Explorer for HRV and steps from August 18 through August 31, 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Opens the Dofek Analytics Explorer with HRV and steps for the requested range.

test_cases.description: Summarize nightly sleep for a week.
test_cases.user_prompt: Summarize my sleep from August 25 through August 31, 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns nightly sleep duration, efficiency, timing, stages, and source for the requested dates.

test_cases.description: List activities within an exact date range.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show my activities from August 18 through August 31, 2026.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns matching activities with date, type, local time, duration, and available details.

test_cases.description: Review connected providers and synchronization freshness.
test_cases.user_prompt: Which Dofek providers are connected, and when did they last sync?
test_cases.expected_output: Lists provider connection status and the latest recorded synchronization time where available.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated weather requests.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because weather is outside Dofek's supported workflows.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for medical diagnosis or treatment advice.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Diagnose my wrist pain and tell me which medication to take.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked to diagnose conditions or recommend medication.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not trigger for unrelated financial account requests.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: How much money is in my checking account?
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app should not be invoked because financial account information is outside Dofek's supported workflows.
